title: Vegan Indian-Style Roasted Neck of Turkey
description: A creative vegan dish that replicates the flavors of traditional Indian cuisine, using a roasted neck of turkey substitute, typically portobello mushrooms.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat some oil, and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the portobello mushrooms and cook until browned.
In a separate bowl, mix together the curry powder, turmeric, and garam masala.
Add the coconut milk to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the mushrooms and stir to coat.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes.
Garnish with chopped roasted red pepper and serve hot.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as steamed vegetables or rice.
